title: Beyond Perfect Teammates: Multi-Agent Collaboration with Unreliable Colleagues
abstract: arXiv:2610.16117v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent collaboration is increasingly used to solve complex tasks by dividing work among specialized agents and integrating complementary expertise. Yet existing systems and evaluations largely rest on an implicit perfect-colleague assumption: collaborators provide correct and complete information and respond promptly to requests. In realistic teamwork, however, collaborators may return information that does not answer the intended question, provide insufficient detail to support a decision, or fail to respond to a request. To separate task-solving competence from the ability to recover an unreliable evidence-gathering process, we introduce the Unreliable Colleagues Benchmark (UnCoBench), which organizes behavioral failures through Misaligned, Incomplete, and Missed settings. translated_title: 超越完美队友：与不可靠同事的多智能体协作
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的多智能体协作正日益被用于解决复杂任务，其方式是在专业化的智能体之间进行分工并整合互补的专业知识。然而，现有的系统和评估在很大程度上依赖于一个隐含的“完美同事”假设：协作者提供正确且完整的信息，并及时响应请求。但在现实的团队合作中，协作者可能返回未能回答预期问题的信息、提供的细节不足以支持决策，或者根本不响应请求。为了将任务解决能力与从不可靠的证据收集过程中恢复的能力区分开来，我们提出了不可靠同事基准（UnCoBench），该基准通过“错位”、“不完整”和“遗漏”三类设置来组织行为失效模式。主智能体需要验证上下文的正确性、诊断信息缺口并跟踪未解决的依赖关系，以获取正确的证据。
tldr: 该论文提出了不可靠同事基准（UnCoBench），通过错位、不完整和遗漏三类协作者失效场景，首次将智能体的任务解决能力与其应对不可靠队友、诊断信息缺口并恢复证据收集过程的能力区分开来。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Unreliable Colleagues Benchmark (UnCoBench), which uses Misaligned, Incomplete, and Missed collaborator failure settings to separate task-solving competence from the ability to verify, diagnose, and recover from unreliable teammates in multi-agent collaboration.
